title: An Organ Performance That Began in 2001 Ends in 2640
hook: A church in Germany is in the middle of a 639 year organ performance

open.title: A sandbag sits on a German church organ pedal, and the music plays on
open.line: St. Burchardi church in Halberstadt, Germany. The organ has no one sitting at it, yet sound carries on even now.

summary: John Cage's piece As Slow as Possible is being played from 2001 to 2640, a span of 639 years. Sandbags press the pedals to sustain the sound, and the note changes once every few months or years.

text: In a Halberstadt, Germany church, a sandbag rests on an organ pedal.
Sound goes on with no one pressing.
It's playing John Cage's As Slow as Possible.
639 years: from about 1361, when the city's cathedral first had a recorded permanent organ, to 2000.
Lack of money delayed the start by a year.
Actually, the first year and a half was silent.
It opens with a rest, so the first sound came February 5, 2003.
The note changes every few months or years.
It always changes on the 5th of the month.
In 2011 the organ got an acrylic case to cut noise.
